claims.text: Tác phẩm có thật, tên: Le Monde

sources.quote: 1664, Le monde, ou, Le traite de la lumiere
a larger work, Le Monde (The World)
In a letter to Mersenne, dated November 1633, Descartes expresses his fear that were he to publish The World

Works published posthumously included his Compendium of Music (in Latin, 1650), Letters (in Latin and French, 1657–67); World, or Treatise on Light, containing the core of his natural philosophy (in French, 1664)

claims.text: years_ok: 1633 — năm sách soạn xong, sẵn sàng in

sources.quote: When The World had become ready for publication in 1633, upon hearing of the Church’s condemnation of Galileo (1564–1642) in the same year, Descartes decided against its publication

claims.text: year_note: soạn 1629–1633, in sau khi tác giả mất năm 1664

sources.quote: It is here in 1629 that Descartes began work on “a little treatise,” which took him approximately three years to complete, entitled The World.
When The World had become ready for publication in 1633

Works published posthumously included his Compendium of Music (in Latin, 1650), Letters (in Latin and French, 1657–67); World, or Treatise on Light, containing the core of his natural philosophy (in French, 1664)

notes: 1664 là năm in lần đầu, sau khi Descartes mất; sách soạn xong khoảng 1633 và bị ông rút lại sau vụ Galileo (SEP descartes-works: 'When The World had become ready for publication in 1633'). Đề xuất year_note: 'soạn 1629–1633, in sau khi mất năm 1664'. Kiểm lại 5.1b: years_ok 1633 và year_note đúng (IEP: bắt đầu 1629, khoảng ba năm; SEP: sẵn sàng in 1633, in di cảo 1664).
